name: Gambling
description: Test your luck with coin flip, slots, blackjack, and Red Zone

commands.name: gamble
commands.description: Gamble coins on a coin flip
commands.longDescription: A simple 50/50 coin flip. Win double your bet or lose it all. Quick and risky.
tips: 50/50 odds - true coin flip
Win = double your bet
Bet range: 10 - 10,000 coins

commands.name: slots
commands.longDescription: Spin three reels with football-themed symbols. Match symbols to win multipliers up to 100x your bet!
tips: Triple Jackpot (🎰🎰🎰) = 100x bet
Triple Trophy (🏆🏆🏆) = 25x bet
Triple Gold (🥇🥇🥇) = 10x bet
Two matching = 2x bet

commands.name: blackjack
commands.longDescription: Classic blackjack against the dealer. Use buttons to Hit, Stand, Double Down, or Surrender. Soft hands display clearly (e.g., 'Soft 17'). Your stats and streaks are tracked automatically!

examples.output:
Your hand: A♠ 6♥ (Soft 17)
Dealer shows: 5♦
[Hit] [Stand] [Double Down] [Surrender]

Your hand: K♠ 7♥ (17)
Dealer: 5♦ 10♣ 8♠ (Bust!)
🎉 You win! +100 coins
Current streak: 🔥 3 wins

tips: Surrender returns 50% of your bet (before first hit only)
Soft hands (with Ace as 11) display as 'Soft X'
Double Down doubles your bet for one more card
Dealer stands on 17
Blackjack (21 on first two cards) pays 1.5x
Play Again button lets you quickly replay with the same bet
Your win/loss streaks are tracked and displayed
Game times out after 2 minutes

commands.name: blackjackstats
commands.longDescription: View comprehensive blackjack statistics including games played, win rate, profit/loss, streaks, double down success rate, and more. Can view your own stats or another player's.

options.name: user
options.description: User to view stats for (defaults to yourself)

examples.output:
📊 Blackjack Stats for @You
Games: 150 (75W - 60L - 15P)
Win Rate: 55.6%
Blackjacks: 12 | Busts: 28
Double Success: 62.5% (25/40)
💰 Wagered: 15,000 | Profit: +2,350
🏆 Biggest Win: 500
🔥 Best Streak: 8 | 😢 Worst: -5

tips: Win rate is calculated from wins / (wins + losses)
Profit = total won - total wagered
Double down success rate shows how often your doubles win
Pushes don't count toward win/loss streaks

commands.name: blackjackleaderboard
commands.longDescription: View top 10 players across 7 different leaderboard categories: games played, total wins, win rate, natural blackjacks, net profit, best win streak, and biggest single win.
tips: Win rate leaderboard requires minimum 20 games to qualify
Profit = total won - total wagered over all games
Streak shows best consecutive win streak ever achieved
Blackjacks counts natural 21s (Ace + 10-value on first two cards)

commands.name: redzone
commands.description: Push your luck football game - drive for a touchdown!
commands.longDescription: A push-your-luck football minigame. Start at your own 20-yard line and try to drive 80 yards for a touchdown. Each play gains 5-20 yards, but fumble risk increases as you get closer to the end zone. Cash out anytime to lock in your multiplier, or risk it all for the 10x touchdown payout!

examples.output:
🏈 RED ZONE 🏈
[======>              ]
Own 40 | Multiplier: 1.5x | Fumble Risk: 12%
[🏈 Run Play] [💰 Cash Out]

💥 FUMBLE! 💥
The defense recovers at the Opp 30!
You lost your bet.

tips: Start at your own 20 with 0% fumble risk
Fumble chance increases as you advance (up to 52% at the opponent's 10)
Cash out anytime to lock in your current multiplier
Touchdown = 10x payout, but you must survive the drive
Each play gains 5-20 yards randomly
Play Again button lets you quickly restart with the same bet
Your touchdown streaks are tracked!

commands.name: redzoneleaderboard
commands.longDescription: View top 10 players across 6 different Red Zone leaderboard categories: most touchdowns, highest TD rate, longest drive, net profit, best TD streak, and biggest single win.

examples.output:
🏈 Red Zone Leaderboard - Most Touchdowns
🥇 @Speedster: 47 TDs (62% rate)
🥈 @Gridiron: 35 TDs (45% rate)
🥉 @EndZone: 28 TDs (58% rate)

🏈 Red Zone Leaderboard - Longest Drive
🥇 @Marathon: 95 yards (1,250 total)
🥈 @Rusher: 88 yards (890 total)

tips: TD rate leaderboard requires minimum 10 games to qualify
Longest drive tracks your best single-game yardage
TD streaks count consecutive touchdowns (cashouts reset streak)
Profit = total won - total wagered
